newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Two more Bahrainis arrested in Kuwait.
newsitem.headline: Two more Bahrainis arrested in Kuwait.

text.p: Kuwait has arrested two more Bahrainis for plotting against an unnamed country, the Arab Times reported on Wednesday.
"The two Bahraini nationals were charged with forgery and indulging in hostile acts against a foreign country," the daily quoted a security source as saying.
The newspaper said the two were involved with a group, which included 11 Bahraini Shi'ite Moslems, that was arrested on March 26 for planning sabotage against a fellow Gulf Arab state.
The group's lawyer, Khaled al-Shatti, was quoted by Arab Times as saying that the case was blown out of proportion for political reasons while the Bahrainis are yet to be charged.
Kuwaiti officials had earlier said that a non-Kuwaiti Arab group was arrested last month.
Shatti said that six of the 11 were recently freed and "were given the choice to leave the country if they wanted".

Members of Bahrain's majority Shi'ite community have waged sporadic protests, bombings and arson attacks in the island state since Decemeber 1994 to press for political and economic reforms by the Sunni-led government.
